promises.target: outpacing loan growth in the coming year in FY '27
promises.quote: hence, we believe and we are very optimistic about outpacing loan growth in the coming year in FY '27, as we had sort of mentioned to you all along for the last 18 months.
and then maybe by FY '27, by the natural growth and even with the growth in the way we are expecting in terms of faster growth rate, I think we should land somewhere around the 85% to 90% for FY '27.

reported.quote: LCR, we reported 116 in this quarter.
If you look at the recent time period for card spend, which is important for you to look at, the overall card spend up 15%, 3.4% sequentially.
Within the card spend, when we look at the discretionary category of card spends, the discretionary category spends have grown 21% year-on-year.
The non-discretionary, which is the bread and butter normal activity is about 13% up.
If you look at the per branch productivity, we are now at about INR305 crores or thereabouts on a per branch at an aggregate level.
